notes: *henceforth ... no more* divides three ways, each morpheme holding a word the ASV wrote: *henceforth* to `יָסַף`, *no* to `לֹא`, *more* to `עוֹד`.
The directive `he` of `מִצְרַיְמָה` takes the written *to* as its own unit under rule 32, the name keeping *Egypt*.
The waw at s018 takes the two-word connective *forasmuch as*, headed on the lexeme-carrying *forasmuch*; heading on *as* is the named alternative.
`בַּדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה` leaves the preposition and both articles `unrepresented`: the ASV writes *that way* with the phrase's one determiner going to the demonstrative under rule 41.
